name: DDR Museum Berlin
funding: Private museum financed through admissions; rebuilt following 2022 AquaDom flood.

name: Den Frie Centre of Contemporary Art (Den Frie Udstillingsbygning)
funding: Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond), City of Copenhagen, artist association dues; artist-owned non-profit.
watch: Founded in 1891 by artists breaking away from the official Salon; still owned and run by artists.

name: Denver Art Museum
funding: Metro SCFD arts tax and the City of Denver. FY2025 gifts of $100,000+: Anschutz Foundation, Sarah Shaw Anschutz Foundation; Xcel Energy Foundation $25,000+. UMB Bank co-presented the 2026 Delight gala.
watch: Anschutz Exploration still drills for oil and gas; Sarah S. Anschutz chairs the board. Sponsor UMB Bank was campaigned against at Kemper in 2019.
records_note: Posts annual reports from 2002-03 to 2024-25 with donor names and a financial section, and names its trustees; Form 990s sit on ProPublica.

name: Des Moines Art Center
funding: It paid artist Mary Miss $900,000 to settle her 2024 lawsuit.
watch: Miss sued in April 2024 to stop removal of Greenwood Pond: Double Site; removal began in February 2025. An artist-rights dispute, not about funders.
records_note: It posts annual reports for 2009 to 2025, Form 990s for 2013 to 2024, a 2025 donor list by gift level and 22 trustees.

name: DESTE Foundation for Contemporary Art
funding: Private foundation set up in Geneva in 1983 by collector Dakis Joannou, a construction and hotel businessman.
watch: Runs the Athens space and the Slaughterhouse Project Space on Hydra, granted by the island's municipality in 2008. NEON belongs to Daskalopoulos, not Joannou.
records_note: DESTE's About page names no donors or sponsors, and the site publishes no annual reports, accounts or board.

name: Deutsches Historisches Museum
funding: Federal Government Commissioner for Culture and the Media (BKM) financing.
watch: Germany's national history museum; public funding and governance, federal memory culture, and historical provenance.

name: Dia Beacon
funding: Dia Art Foundation endowment, Andrew W. Mellon Foundation, individual board patrons.
watch: Dropped the Sackler name 2019; Schlumberger origin.

name: Dia Chelsea
funding: Dia Art Foundation endowment ($110M), board contributions, and New York State Council on the Arts. Always free admission.
watch: Dropped the Sackler name 2019; Schlumberger origin.

name: Die Neue Sammlung - The Design Museum
funding: 2025: Bavarian state museum; its centenary show was funded by the Bavarian arts ministry and PIN. Freunde, whose corporate partner is Allianz (insurance).
watch: Insurance money (Allianz) reaches it through PIN., its friends' association.
records_note: This Bavarian state museum posts no annual reports, accounts, funder list or board; sponsors appear only as credits on exhibition pages.

name: doual'art
funding: Independent non-profit (1991) relying on international grant-makers and sponsors.
watch: Runs the SUD Salon Urbain de Douala; roster not public.
records_note: Its site footer names five supporters, including Arts Collaboratory and Brot für die Welt, but undated; no annual report, accounts or board are posted.
